airnow.title: AirNow: observations by station
airnow.description: One station per line, sorted by id, its window as columns. A station's `offset` and `length` in the index are the byte span of its line's JSON object, excluding the newline, so one station is one `Range: bytes=<offset>-<offset+length-1>` request and the whole file streams line by line.

airnow.stations.title: AirNow: stations and current values
airnow.stations.description: One row per station, sorted by id: position, rank, name, newest time, the current value of each element and the byte span of the station's line in the network's NDJSON file.
